about: Where every record and image on The Halving comes from. Every symbol is a real Bitcoin record drawn as a data tile in the machine's style, or the Bitcoin mark. No NFT, inscription or third-party project logo appears on these reels.

cherry.name: Block 210,000 (the first halving, 50 → 25 BTC)
cherry.kind: On-chain record: block height, hash, date, pool and coinbase text

block.name: Block 840,000 (6.25 → 3.125 BTC; the block Runes launched in)
block.source: mempool.space API, /api/v1/blocks/840000; hash cross-checked with the Hiro API burn-block record

artifact.name: Block 1,050,000 (the next halving)
artifact.kind: Live on-chain record: 1,050,000 minus the live tip height
artifact.source: Live: https://mempool.space/api/blocks/tip/height, falling back to the Hiro API (https://xtrata.xyz/hiro/mainnet/extended/v2/burn-blocks?limit=1, then https://api.hiro.so). Bundled fallback: tip 974,196 at build (75,804 blocks to go). A failed read shows the last known value marked STALE.

bitcoin.name: 21,000,000 (the supply cap)
bitcoin.kind: On-chain rule: the sum of every block subsidy (50 BTC halving every 210,000 blocks)
bitcoin.source: Bitcoin consensus rules (src/validation.cpp GetBlockSubsidy in Bitcoin Core); set in type

wild.source: Bitcoin.org repository, img/icons/logotop.svg (https://github.com/bitcoin-dot-org/Bitcoin.org/blob/master/img/icons/logotop.svg): the coin mark taken from it as supplied, saved as art/bitcoin-mark.svg. Bitcoin.org states the logo is in the public domain.

scatter.name: Subsidy coin: 50, 25, 12.5, 6.25 or 3.125 BTC
scatter.kind: On-chain rule: the block subsidy of each era
scatter.source: Bitcoin consensus rules (GetBlockSubsidy); coin faces drawn in the machine's style from the amounts

vault.name: Coinbase message
vault.kind: On-chain record: readable text decoded from the coinbase script (scriptSig) of historic blocks, with its height
vault.source: mempool.space API extras.coinbaseRaw for each block; decoded by tools/the-halving/build_records.py (each coinbase's BIP34 height push is checked against the block height)

chain.name: Mined block
chain.kind: Live on-chain record: a recent block height with the name of the pool that mined it
chain.source: Live: https://mempool.space/api/v1/blocks. Bundled fallback: blocks 974,161–974,190 read at build; hashes of 974,175, 974,176 and 974,190 cross-checked against the Hiro API. Pool names appear as text only.

cabinet.xtrataMark: tools/the-halving/model/assets/xtrata.svg, the brand SVG supplied in the build prompt, embedded as supplied on the lower door (house mark)
cabinet.parallaxWordmark: tools/the-halving/model/assets/parallax-wordmark.svg, the wordmark supplied in the build prompt, embedded small at the marquee foot (house mark)
cabinet.bitcoinMark: art/bitcoin-mark.svg (Bitcoin.org, public domain), on the marquee
cabinet.everythingElse: Concrete, steel, fan grilles, split-flap boards, hazard stripes, buttons and labels are procedural textures written by tools/the-halving/model/textures.py; no third-party artwork.

twins.what: The Epoch Pot's twin count (display only)
twins.source: https://xtrata.xyz/forever-twins/data/registry.v2.json and each live helper's contract events via https://xtrata.xyz/hiro/mainnet (fallback https://api.hiro.so). A failed read is shown as unknown, never as zero.

permissionNotes: None needed. The only logos are the Xtrata mark and ParallaX Casino wordmark (house marks) and the Bitcoin mark (public domain, from Bitcoin.org). Mining-pool names appear as plain text from block data; no pool logo is used. If pool logos are ever added, each needs the pool's official file and its permission.
